title: Anatomi Workspace Canva
html:
Area kerja Canva dirancang intuitif dengan pembagian zona fungsional:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Toolbar Atas (Home, File, Resize, Undo/Redo, Share)   │
├───────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┤
│               │                                        │
│ Sidebar Panel │             Canvas Kerja               │
│ (Templates,   │          (Area Bidang Desain)          │
│ Elements,     │                                        │
│ Text, Uploads,│                                        │
│ Projects)     │                                        │
│               │                                        │
├───────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Toolbar Kontekstual (Font, Size, Color, Spacing, Pos)  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Perhatikan menu navigasi utama: Home, Templates, Elements, Text, Uploads, Projects, Canvas, Position Toolbar, serta tombol Share dan Download.
